name: team_2022
caption:
IF OUR 2022 FINALS STARTERS WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

☀️ Steph Curry = Solgaleo: it lights up the darkest night like midday. 27.4 a night in the playoffs, first Finals MVP
🐢 Klay Thompson = Wartortle: a symbol of longevity. Back after 2.5 years out, 19.0 a night in the playoffs
🥋 Andrew Wiggins = Mienshao: whips its long arms too fast to see. 7.5 rebounds a night in the playoffs
🐊 Draymond Green = Krookodile: never lets its prey escape. 6.3 assists a night in the playoffs
🗿 Kevon Looney = Golett: a mysterious energy keeps it moving. All 82 games, 80 starts

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇

facts.claim: Our starters in Game 1 of the 2022 Finals: Draymond Green, Andrew Wiggins, Kevon Looney, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
Curry: NBA Finals MVP (2022), his first
Thompson: after missing over two and a half (2.5) years of play due to injury, returned in the middle of the 2021-22 season and won his fourth title in 2022
Wiggins played stifling defense on Boston forward Jayson Tatum in the 2022 Finals
Looney played in all 82 games of the 2021-22 regular season, making a career-high 80 starts; won his third championship in 2022
Solgaleo: the intense light it radiates from its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday
Wartortle: it is recognized as a symbol of longevity
Mienshao: it wields the fur on its arms like a whip; its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen
Krookodile: they never allow prey to escape; their jaws can crush the body of an automobile
Golett: its movements are powered by a mysterious energy; it has continued to move since ancient times
